place.name: Museum of Italian Judaism and the Shoah
place.description: The Museum of Italian Judaism and the Shoah (MEIS) (Italian: Museo Nazionale dell’Ebraismo Italiano e della Shoah) is a public history museum in Ferrara, Italy. It opened in 2017, and traces the history of the Jewish people in Italy starting from the Roman Empire through the Holocaust of the 20th century.
